design_reference: Editeur Livre-Jeu - Wireframes.dc.html § 01 step 1 « Accueil de l'app » (the BINDING target: header « Mes livres » + account dot; a grid of book tiles; a dashed accent « + » tile that creates a book). Tile/card anatomy + the dashed-accent create affordance + tokens from styles.css. Low-fi, light theme.

plan.goal: The app's home screen: list the author's books, create one (delegating to book-creation), open one into the editor, and delete one behind a confirmation — the entry point before any book is open.

design_contract._binding: Rebuild § 01 step 1 with design-system components; DS tokens win over prose.
design_contract.header: « Mes livres » title (--fs-title/700) + a muted account/avatar dot, on var(--surface-card).
design_contract.grid: Responsive grid of book tiles (var(--r-md) tiles, 1px var(--border-subtle), var(--surface-inset)). Each tile shows the title (--fs-body/600) and a muted created/edited meta line; hover reveals an open affordance and a ✕/⋯ delete entry.
design_contract.create_tile: A dashed accent tile (1.5px dashed var(--accent), centered accent « + », « Nouveau livre ») that opens the book-creation dialog.
design_contract.delete_guard: Delete opens a `surfaces/Modal` confirmation (destructive slot, terracotta) — « Supprimer ce livre ? » — never a one-click destroy.
design_contract.empty_state: Zero books → a large centered dashed create tile + an inviting line « Créez votre premier livre » (project-wide empty-state rule).

acceptance_criteria: The home screen lists every persisted book as a tile (title + meta), read from BookService.listBooks(), and updates live when a book is created or deleted (book:created / book:deleted).
A dashed accent « + Nouveau livre » tile opens the book-creation dialog; book-library does not itself implement seeding — it delegates to book-creation and reacts to book:created.
Clicking a tile opens that book: it routes to the editor (canvas view) for that bookId and emits book:opened.

Deleting a tile requires confirmation via a destructive Modal; on confirm, BookService removes the book and its tree, the tile disappears, and book:deleted{bookId} is emitted; cancel leaves everything untouched.
Deleting the currently-open book (if any) is handled gracefully — the user is returned to the library, never left in a dead editor.
Book ids are stable and used as keys; duplicate titles render fine and are distinguishable by meta; the list survives reload (PersistenceService) and reflects cloud-synced books when online.
Zero-books shows the empty-state create affordance, not a blank screen (empty-state rule).
All chrome renders from design-system tokens/components, light theme; tiles and the create affordance have ≥44px hit targets and are keyboard-accessible.
plan.walking_skeleton: List books from BookService as tiles; a create tile opens the book-creation dialog (already built) and the list refreshes on book:created; clicking a tile routes to the editor + emits book:opened. Add delete with a confirm Modal emitting book:deleted. No sort/search/empty-polish yet.

iterations.goal: Faithful render of § 01 step 1: header, responsive tile grid from BookService.listBooks(), dashed accent create tile wired to book-creation, open-on-click routing + book:opened. Live refresh on book:created. Design-system fidelity.

Delete flow: hover delete entry → destructive confirm Modal → BookService.removeBook → tile removal + book:deleted; safe handling when deleting the open book; ConfirmDialog reused from brain/components (KR-109).
Library quality of life: sort (recent/edited), optional search, empty-state affordance, and online/offline + sync-status reflection from CloudSyncService (sync:status) without blocking the list.

known_risks: KR-040 — Delete is destructive and must be guarded by a confirm Modal (brain ConfirmDialog) and routed through BookService; a stray one-click delete loses an author's entire book. Deleting must also clean up the book's tree + persisted positions, leaving no orphaned keys.
KR-041 — book-library must NOT re-implement creation/seeding; it delegates to book-creation and only reacts to book:created (single seeding path, re-asserts KR-001).
KR-042 — Deleting the currently-open book must return the user to the library, not strand them in an editor pointed at a deleted bookId.
KR-043 — The list reflects both local and cloud-synced books; on first load it must render local immediately and reconcile cloud results without flicker/duplication (cloud-first).
KR-011 — No raw localStorage; read/write only via BookService/PersistenceService (global config KR-111).
KR-109 — Reuse the shared ConfirmDialog from brain/components rather than a local modal, to avoid cross-feature drift.
A11y — tiles, create affordance, and delete entries are keyboard-reachable; the confirm Modal traps focus and restores it on close.

resolved_decisions: book-library is the editor's home; opening a book routes into the editor. Launching a book to PLAY it (play mode) is a separate surface, out of scope here.
Creation is delegated to book-creation; the library never seeds directly.
open_questions: Tile meta: show « modifié le … » (last edited) vs « créé le … » — leaning last-edited, which requires BookService to track an updated_at.
